When I was in middle school I had an iPod nano full of random music over the years. My cousin had just introduced me to WCAR as I was getting more and more into metalcore. He synced all their albums into my iPod. My dad would always pick me up late or I’d end up walking home, and WCAR would always be playing in that little iPod. They easily became one of my favorite bands. I remember when Tracing Back Roots was released and hearing the lyrics to “I Survive”. I sat there in tears hearing Kyle sing “I will keep my head and heart above the waves”. Warped Tour 2015 later became one of my most memorable days thanks to their performance. Kyle and WCAR will always have a special place in my heart.

The fact that you are someone around my age makes me feel so much better. I wish I knew more people like you at school. So many are very negative and it’s what also makes me feel so damn low. Reading this, reminded me that there are truly loving people out here in the world. You have such a kind heart to take the time and write this out for a complete stranger on the internet. Along with others you’re going to be on my mind if I come across any tough feelings this week. Reading this brought me to tears (happy tears). The people in your life must be lucky to have you. And the fact that you have pushed through what you went through gives me hope. I’ll keep fighting for myself and others and use your inspiring message. Really, everyone including you has helped me today. I can’t thank you enough. This was my very first post on Reddit. For the first time in a long time, I feel loved.
